replies.text: @GlobalTravelGuide-68 Well that is hard to tell as it ws a rather a non event pasing through VT both times sso nothing stuck. If you interested in my other travel memories I am happy to do a  face to face on messanger, ot teams. That first visit to Lao was part way through a road trip I did starting  in September 72 in London, and traveling overland to Tokyo (except the wet bits), returning to London in December 74. Not sure if you have ever heard of the hippy trail,but that was the first bit. Then I started flying fom one country to another. I started with 300 pounds (the maximum you could take out of the county at the time, and manged to earn money to stretch that over the whole 15 months.

replies.text: @GlobalTravelGuide-68 First time in Lao was a visa run from Thiland in 1973 I  think March. I went in via Chang Mai The was a ceaase fire at the time so I was safe. The only flights from there down to VT was on an old  DC 3. I dont  remember my time in VT, but  do remember the week I spent in LPB. It was just villages where I crossed the river from Thailnd. I returned in 2006 and went to Vang Vieng were an old friend of mine was running a small backpacker G/H called Pans place. At that time there where no drains, and the roads had no tarmac on them.. Another friend I got to to know there arived in VV (2000) when theRe where only 3 G/H in the whole town.
